name: week
title: Purchasing this week
subtitle: Read-only operational snapshot. Net amounts; currencies kept separate.

sections.title: Approvals waiting
sections.sql: select reference,supplier,currency,ordered_value,due_on from order_position where status='draft' order by reference

sections.title: Late deliveries
sections.sql: select reference,description,outstanding,due_on from line_position where status='approved' and outstanding>0 and due_on<current_date order by due_on

sections.title: Budget headroom
sections.sql: select name,currency,committed,requested,remaining from budget_position order by name

sections.title: Invoice matching
sections.sql: select reference,line_ref,description,currency,quantity,received,invoiced,price_variance from line_position where price_variance or invoice_ahead_of_receipt or over_invoiced order by reference

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,record
